shortDescription: Membership registration review screen before payment.
fullDescription: Implements a full new membership review view based on the provided reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg. The screen includes a compact PriceSmart-style top bar, a left-side two-step progress rail, personal data summary with member photo, contact and address sections, secondary membership cards with edit/remove actions, and a footer action row with home, save, and payment buttons using the shared Button component.
